definitions.explanation: A roll of paper or silk with writing or illustrations, traditionally used for documents, paintings, and religious texts in East Asia.
Sushi made by rolling rice and fillings in a sheet of nori (seaweed) using a bamboo mat. Short for {巻|ま}き{寿司|ずし}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{巻物|まきもの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{平安|へいあん}→平安：12641_heian⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{巻物|まきもの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{昼|ひる}→お昼：02532_ohiru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{巻物|まきもの}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
USAGE:
The two meanings are usually clear from context. In historical or cultural contexts, {巻物|まきもの} means a scroll. In food contexts, it refers to rolled sushi (⟦{巻|ま}き{寿司|ずし}→巻き寿司：12410_makizushi⟧). Scrolls are counted with {巻|かん} or {本|ほん}; sushi rolls are counted with {本|ほん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絵|え}{巻物|まきもの}: picture scroll (emakimono)
- {巻物|まきもの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧: unroll a scroll
- ⟦{太|ふと}{巻|ま}き→太巻き：16202_futomaki⟧: thick sushi roll
- ⟦{細|ほそ}{巻|ま}き→細巻き：21366_hosomaki⟧: thin sushi roll
